about: The Google Play listing's inputs beside the copy (docs/how-to/store-listings.md §8): the package, the feature graphic's second line, and the phone screenshots — `manifest` keys (published captures, fetched from R2 by sha256) or a `local` folder of captures not yet published (gitignored, so a fresh clone has none) — the en-US set; `localeScreenshots` gives every other locale its own set in the same shape, or "en-US" for the English one.
